title: Workspace: 3 distinct fixture-loading strategies across 8 extension-types siblings — none mirrors the canonical mail-types fixture() helper
description:
**Divergence**: the canonical extension-types template (mail-types) loads test fixtures via tests/common/mod.rs::fixture(name) -> String reading from tests/fixtures/*.json at runtime. Zero of the 7 extension-types siblings mirror this pattern.

| Crate | tests/ dir | tests/common/ | tests/fixtures/ | Fixture-loading strategy |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| mail-types (canonical) | YES | YES (fixture() helper at tests/common/mod.rs:3-6) | YES (19 .json files) | Runtime fs::read_to_string via helper |
| chat-types | NO | n/a | n/a | Inline r#"…"# literals in #[cfg(test)] mod in src/ |
| calendars-types | YES | NO | NO | Inline literals in tests/types_test.rs |
| tasks-types | YES | NO | YES (5 .json files) | include_str!() at compile time |
| contacts-types | NO | n/a | n/a | Inline literals in src/ |
| filenode-types | YES | NO | NO | Inline r#"…"# literals in tests/filenode_types.rs |
| sharing-types | NO | n/a | n/a | Inline literals in src/ |
| metadata-types | YES | NO | NO | Inline r#"…"# literals in tests/metadata_types.rs |

**Three distinct strategies in 8 siblings**:
1. Runtime via helper — only canonical (mail-types).
2. include_str!() from tests/fixtures/*.json — only tasks-types.
3. Inline r#"…"# JSON literals — six siblings (chat, calendars, contacts, filenode, sharing, metadata).

**Test-file layout splits 3 ways** in parallel: tests/{name}_tests.rs per-domain (canonical), single tests/{crate}_types.rs (filenode, metadata) or tests/types_test.rs (calendars, tasks), or no tests/ dir at all (chat, contacts, sharing).

**Caller-observable / maintainer effect**: directly contradicts the canonical extension-types banner (crate-jmap-mail-types/AGENTS.md:3-19) which says 'same test layout, same serde attribute patterns'. Test layout is plainly not the same. A contributor cookie-cutting a new extension-types crate (e.g. future jmap-blob-types, jmap-quotas-types) has six precedents to pick from and three valid-looking strategies; no signal that mail-types is the one to mirror.

**Fix options**:
(a) Converge all 7 siblings to mirror canonical: add tests/common/mod.rs with fixture() helper, move literals to tests/fixtures/*.json. Largest mechanical change; matches canonical-template rule literally.
(b) Document the three-pattern split as intentional in mail-types AGENTS.md — but this undermines the rule.
(c) Hybrid: hoist fixture() helper to a workspace-shared test-utility crate (jmap-test-utils?) that all 8 extension-types siblings can call. Avoids duplicating the helper 8 times.

Position (a) is the literal-rule fix; (c) is the better DRY shape but requires a new workspace crate.

**Cross-references**: bd:JMAP-ops7.11 (mail-types README structure violation, already closed) — same canonical-template enforcement axis but for README rather than tests/.
notes: DECISION Mark 2026-10-22: option (a) convert every types crate's test JSON to tests/fixtures/*.json loaded via a tests/common fixture() helper, matching crate-jmap-mail-types/tests/common/mod.rs:3. Mechanical: move each inline literal unchanged into a fixture file (byte-for-byte the same JSON, so the oracle does not change); keep spec-example provenance comments. Never alter expected values while moving. Size L: split per crate.
